svg.title: Here pebWeight(p, μ) = P a |ei Re pa −1|2 + μ2. Thus the positive weight uses the real part of momentum even when p is complex. Such a weight is a norm-comparison device; it is not asserted holomorphic. For complex differentiation, freeze the weights at the real anchor and use the analytic TL(p) factors. Comparing the original and frozen weights at nearby momenta gives the fixed height allowance. The link-plus-site frame is the direct sum of (MA8) on link components and the unweighted site frame.
